critique: The garden metaphor creates strong visceral appeal through its growth visualization, but the behavioral layer undermines this poetry with inconsistent progress indicators—fully bloomed flowers for 21-day streaks sit alongside seedlings with mere 2-day counts, breaking the intuitive 'growth equals time' mental model. While the craft details like gradients and iconography are polished, the structural relationship between habit duration and visual representation lacks the logical clarity needed to make the metaphor functionally meaningful rather than merely decorative.
